name: townhall-qa-poll
description: Web application to collect and rank employee questions for town hall meetings

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && FRONTEND_PORT=$(node -p "require('../config/ports.json').dev.frontend") PORT=$(node -p "require('../config/ports.json').dev.backend") npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && FRONTEND_PORT=$(node -p "require('../config/ports.json').dev.frontend") PORT=$(node -p "require('../config/ports.json').dev.backend") npm run dev
scripts.start:frontend:prod: cd frontend && npm run build && npm run preview
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && NODE_ENV=production HOST=0.0.0.0 node src/server.js
scripts.agent-browser:smoke: npm run agent-browser -- open https://example.com && npm run agent-browser -- snapshot -i && npm run agent-browser -- close
